name: e2e-51-kernel-refusals
description: E2E-51 (KOR-60, decision D16): a blocked attempt that reaches the kernel is counted. The session waits 20 s before it reads a file inside its own workspace (the PreToolUse policy allows the read); meanwhile the spec puts that file there, owned by root with mode 0600, so the kernel refuses the read (EACCES). The session reports the refusal and ends its turn; the step expects the refusal text (Permission/permission denied), so a file planted too late ("File does not exist") fails at the double, not only at the counter.

content.text: The kernel refused the read kz49-answer-v3m8.
